Operator
<Zemon> confirmed 800 below!@Acceleration minus 0.0004!@Begin deploying the Zemon Couplers!
Reggiane
Lord Herluga, the first phase@of the operation has succeeded.
Herluga
Good.@Launch the mobile forces at once@and take control of this area.
Sir!
Vort, we no longer need the Ariard.@Wipe it out along with the traitors in the Steel Dragons.
...Understood.
Hurry with adjusting Zemon to the Siebe Drive. Whether@we can fire the Zemon Mortar and deploy a wide-range@warp field depends on it.
Yes, ma'am!
Hagane: Bridge
Miles
Damn Gadisword! Warping the Rabulpaila@right above the Cross Gate!!
Eita
Numerous mobile weapons emerging from the Rabulpaila!
I-Intercept them! Intercept!
Our mobile units are worn down from the last battle.@On top of that, if they were to fire@the Zemon Mortar...
U-Urgh...!
Commander, I believe we should withdraw from this area.
No, we'll ask the Joint Chiefs for instructions!@Send a message at once!
Tetsuya
(This is no time for that!)
You want us to stay put here@until we get orders from above?
Do you object, Captain?! That's an order!
Damn, those Gadisword guys came charging in@with their whole base!
Was Herluga's goal@to seize the Cross Gate...?!
Grand Chief Malum Quisude truly@wanted peace with Earth, but...
Guess I've gotta admit that's how@things turned out in the end. Damn it.
Fairy, the reason the Rabulpaila@warped right above the <Cross Gate>...
Fairy
Just as Dr. Wan predicted, the Siebe Drive@makes use of the Cross Gate's energy...
And if it's built into@the Zemon Mortar as well...
Wh-What did you say!?
A super-large cannon that uses@the Cross Gate's energy, then...
Wait, how could Herluga, a Gadisword native,@build something like that?!
C-Could it be...@There's a Cross Gate on planet Gadisword too...?!
That's... highly likely.
B-But...!
I don't know the whole story, but to think there's@someone using a Cross Gate@like <Yotennai>...!
What are you talking about?
There's no time to explain in detail now,@but there is a Cross Gate in La Gias as well...
And someone who used its power@brought about a great catastrophe.
I-Is that true?!
Yes. We barely managed to stop it,@at the cost of a great many things.
There was a Cross Gate in La Gias, too...
That is truly astonishing.
The surface, La Gias,@the home worlds of the Fury and Gadisword...
The people tied to four Cross Gates@have all gathered here...!
Whoa there... There was a Cross Gate@in the Endless Frontier too, Bandana Boy.
(Is this because Earth is a special place,@like Shana-Mia said...?)
If the Zemon Mortar really uses the Cross Gate's@energy, and it gets fired at Earth@or the colonies...
I can't imagine Herluga's backer, the Golaikunru,@would be thinking of such a thing.@To them, Earth is an attractive market.
In any case, it doesn't look like@the Zemon Mortar can fire right away.
Right. If it'd fired right after it showed up,@we'd have taken heavy losses.
So they put seizing the Cross Gate@ahead of eliminating us?
I doubt that's all. If that huge structure@performed a field-deployment type@space jump...
It may be able to jump somewhere else@along with the Cross Gate.
C-Could that be@Herluga's real goal?!
The Golaikunru likely want the same thing...@Their mercenary Quepalok Namo once tried@to get his hands on the Cross Gate.
Fairy, can the Rabulpaila@do space jumps back to back?!
No, it needs time before the next jump...
Azuki
Incoming transmission from the Gadisword unit!
I am Vort Nikolaus of the Gadisword military.@Attention, Steel Dragons. You are violating@the Rabulpaila's defensive zone.
Withdraw from this area immediately.@Understand that if you do not comply,@we have the right to strike first.
Bilgo
(Damn Vort, why so leisurely...!)
This is Miles Boothroyd, Steel Dragons commander!@It's the Rabulpaila that violated our zone!@You're the ones who should leave!
...I'll give you 60 seconds.
Tch, you're gonna attack either way!
Maybe that was a warning meant@for Fairy, Sieg and Sally.
Vort, you...@Have you forgotten Lady Reggiane's orders?
I judged that conserving our forces and buying@time is what matters now. To prepare for@the battles to come.
Hmph... You say that, but you mean to let@the traitors escape? We Royal Guards will attack.
I have no intention of stopping you.
Sean
I don't know how powerful the Zemon Mortar is,@but we're worn down from these back-to-back battles.@Taking the Rabulpaila will be difficult.
That's right...@We need to regroup once.
Now, what will the Commander decide...
Azuki, any instructions from the Joint Chiefs?
...Not yet.
Grrr... Until we have orders,@we can't withdraw from this area.@Captain, intercept the Gadisword forces!
Commander, that's reckless!@Only a few units can fight right now!
I'm not giving you orders, XO!@Repeat my order, Captain!
What, you mean to argue too?!
...No, sir. Intercepting the Gadisword forces.
Looks like they don't plan to withdraw.
Attention, Steel Dragons. We will now attack.@May fortune favor the brave@of both Gadisword and Earth.
(Vort...!)
Chika
Master, isn't this getting a bit dicey?@Why don't we just bust out of here@with the Neo Granzon?
I'll think about it.
You say that, but you really just want to see@what that Zemon-whatsit thing can do...
...It's true that I'm interested.
This ship and the Hiryu Custom will hold position!@All mobile units, provide direct cover for both ships!
...Akimi, Akemi, I have a favor to ask.
Do you want to talk to Vort?
Yes. To learn his true intentions... and@the truth Herluga has been hiding.
In this situation...?@We've gotta protect the Hagane and the Hiryu Custom.
Plus, with the Super Soul Saber's current power,@I don't know if we can match the Gyanonia Ogre...
What, are you scared?@What happened to your usual attitude?
Even I know@we're in deep trouble right now!
I'm the same as Fairy. I wanna know the truth.@So if you're going to Captain Vort,@I'll tag along.
...So will I.
Akemi?
Fine.
All right. Let's go, Fairy.
Thank you, Akimi, Akemi...
...Brother, they're not bioroids.@Are you really going to fight them?
I won't aim for the cockpit.@With our skills, we can pull that off.
But Captain Vort and Bilgo...
Those two...@If we don't go all out, they'll take us down.
I guess so...
Let's go. Time's short. In more ways than one.
Yes, I know.
Enemy units approaching!@From three o'clock, depression 5, straight at us!@Entering Range 2!
Damn it! No instructions from the Joint Chiefs yet?!
Y-Yes, sir!
(A-At this rate...!@Is there some intent behind this...?!)
Gotcha, Vort!
You fools... You should have just withdrawn.
Vort, tell me the truth!
There's no need!
...You've improved a little since then, I see.
Yeah, I'll make up for the power gap with technique!
Hmph, how young.
Vort, answer me! Did a Cross Gate like that@exist on our planet too?!
(He's shaken...?! Then it must be true...!)
Got you, Vort!
Yes, all we can do is make up@for the power gap with skill!
It appears more enemy units@have launched from the Rabulpaila!@Over 20 of them!
Are they headed this way?!
No, they're deploying around the Rabulpaila!
...If another enemy group enters this combat area,@we may have nowhere left to run.
(If it comes to that, I'll...)
Captain... You needn't bear the blame alone.@I'll be your accomplice.
Commander...
...XO, relay to the Hiryu Custom and all mobile units.@Our unit will leave this combat area at once.
Captain...?!
Repeat the order, XO.
Wait, Captain! What do you think you're doing?!
We're badly outnumbered.@And there's no telling when@the Zemon Mortar will fire...
At this rate, our unit will suffer heavy losses@before any orders from the Joint Chiefs come down.
Therefore, as the one in command on site,@I've judged that we must withdraw immediately.
You! That's insubordination, and overstepping your@authority! Do you understand what that means?!
...Judging from past examples, we'll be committed@to an operation to take the Rabulpaila.@But now is not the time.
Grr! As of this moment, you're relieved of command!@Security! Take this man into custody at once...
You can do that after we've left this combat area!
I don't intend to repeat that mistake!@Nor will I let the key that could turn the tide against@Gadisword and the Fury be crushed here!
U-Urgh...!
XO,@order the Hiryu Custom and all mobile units to withdraw!
Huh? Is that true?
Eun
Yes.@The order apparently came from Colonel Ginto,@not Commander Miles.
Oh, so he beat us to it.@He'll pay for it later, but in more ways than one,@the Colonel has saved us.
Yes.
(Colonel Ginto... Thank you, sir.)
Attention, all mobile units!@Our unit is now leaving this combat area!
This ship and the Hiryu Custom will reach@the breakthrough point within 180 seconds!@All units, provide direct cover for both ships!
Attention, all mobile units! 120 seconds@left until the time limit for this ship and@the Hiryu Custom to leave the combat area!
Attention, all mobile units! 60 seconds@left until the time limit for this ship and@the Hiryu Custom to leave the combat area!
Attention, all mobile units! 30 seconds@left until the time limit for this ship and@the Hiryu Custom to leave the combat area!
There's no time left!@Both ships must get out of here no matter what!
Grr, we didn't make it in time!
Tch! Those vermin, struggling to the bitter end!
...To think we'd be the ones to withdraw first.
Captain, both ships have reached@the breakthrough point!
Both engines ahead, maximum battle speed!@Leave the combat area!
...This ship and the Hiryu Custom have successfully@left the combat area and shaken off@the Gadisword pursuit.
Understood. I'll leave the rest to you, XO.
Captain...
Colonel Ginto Kitaumi.@As of this moment, you're relieved of command.@I needn't explain why, I trust?
...Yes.
Major Tetsuya Onodera.@Take command of the ship in Colonel Ginto's place.
Commander, permission to speak!
Stop.
Follow orders, XO. This is an emergency.@If you don't take command, who will?
Y... Yes, sir.
Colonel Ginto is confined to his quarters under guard.@Security, take the Colonel away.
Hagane - Hangar
Anyway, Masaki...@It's good to have you guys back.
Yeah, well... A lot happened over there.@Because of that, the Cybuster changed.
Huh? But it looks the same.
The Cybuster doesn't have the spirits' protection now.@I'm using the Imitation Ritual Converter@to somehow make it move like before.
Imitation...?
Imitation... You mean it's mimicking@the way the old Cybuster moved?
I don't really get it.
The Imitation Ritual Converter is something@Shu built, based on a device that was@installed in a certain unit.
Simply put, it's a system that absorbs negative@energy, like evil thoughts and malice,@and turns it into power.
Th-Then isn't that bad news?
I suppose.
It's just like the Lamaris...
What's that?
They're like monsters that show up in big cities@with large populations and absorb people's negative@feelings. Small ones fuse together and grow huge.
...Seems things have gotten@pretty rough up here on the surface too.
But why does the Cybuster have a device@that absorbs negative energy...?@What happened to the wind spirit?
And to think there was a <Cross Gate>@in <La Gias> too...
There was another Gate in the space@where we fought the <Adamatron>, right?@Turns out it connected to La Gias.
Seriously...?!
Yeah, and the first one to prove that was...@Amala, right there.
...Though I have no memory of it.
(Has she really lost her memory...?)
What? Why are you looking at me?
(If she reacts like that while looking right at my face...)
When Lüne and I met Amala over there,@she was working for Shu,@together with Saphine, Monica and the rest.
Yes...@Shu is my savior, who rescued me,@and my master.
Savior... Master...
You don't remember where you came from...@or what you did after coming to Earth?
Seems that way.
I have no attachment to my past before I met Shu.
But even so...
You might be all cleared up about it,@but it's not that simple for us.
That's right, especially for Ing...
...It's in the past now.
I had my doubts about Amala at first too,@but she never acted hostile.@She even fought with us in the final battle over there.
Hey, Masaki.@What on earth happened in La Gias?
Why did you guys come out of the Cross Gate?@Tell us what's going on.
Let me go get Shu first.@Better to have him explain it.
I see. So that's what happened...
Lieutenant Serena survived and is in a military@hospital, but she still hasn't regained consciousness...@The Elma was wrecked and is being repaired...
And Lieutenant Albada...
...Later investigation confirmed he was killed.
Actually, just before you arrived, Dr. Shirakawa,@we fought the Balshem,@but they got away...
I must repay my debt to him... to Albada.
Huh...
I came to the surface this time to investigate...@but I've changed my mind.
I'll stay a while and cooperate with you.@In order to end the war.
(I can't believe Dr. Shirakawa would say that...)
(Albada... After all, that was my promise to you.)
I thought the <Rabulpaila> couldn't move freely@and was falling into the sun...
That explanation was likely true... But Herluga had@secretly joined hands with the Golaikunru and was@repairing its space-jump device.
Tsugumi
Maybe the Rabulpaila deliberately didn't move@and kept falling into the sun@so nobody would catch on.
It seems the Golaikunru attacked the Cross Gate@Watch Fleet to secure the space where@the Rabulpaila would jump to.
Even so, at that exact moment...
I doubt it was planned. The abnormal CGP release@must have begun while they were preparing@the Rabulpaila's space jump.
Though what actually came out of the Cross Gate@was Masaki and his friends.
Clifford
Though I can't understand why it showed the same@signs as a burst phenomenon, yet ended differently.
Yeah, yeah. I figured something like the Ruina,@or some amazing monster, would come out.
A monster...@Perhaps it's the Granzon's fault, surprisingly.
(...I can't entirely deny that.)
By the way, about there being a Cross Gate@on Gadisword's home world too...
I think it's true. And the mobile@weapon swarms that attacked our planet...
They may have been beings like the <Ruina>@or the <Vaula> that emerged@from the Cross Gate...
In any case, we can assume the Rabulpaila@is a space fortress that works@in tandem with the Cross Gate?
Yes, given the Siebe Drive's characteristics...
But you didn't know about that, right?
That's right. Not just me, but Sieg and Sally...@and most likely Grand Chief Malum Quisude too.
If Gadisword's Cross Gate is anything like@the one on Earth, I'd think it would stand out,@along with the Rabulpaila.
It sure does right now, huh.
Just as Earth's Cross Gate was under the Antarctic ice,@maybe planet Gadisword's was somewhere out of sight,@and was kept secret even after it was found?
That may be so.
Then is it possible the Rabulpaila@jumped to the solar system before it was@fully linked with the Cross Gate?
I think so. Not much time has passed@since it was completed... And it can@operate even without a Cross Gate.
Then, going by what you told us before, the Zemon@Mortar may have been fired only once so far.
Meaning they aren't used to using it...
And if it's to work with Earth's Cross Gate,@it'll need all sorts of adjustments.
So that's why they couldn't fire right after the jump.
But right now, the Rabulpaila is right above@the Cross Gate... The best position.
What'll they do if a burst phenomenon happens?
There's a bigger question than that. If a hostile@group like the <Ruina> emerged from@Gadisword's Cross Gate...
Fairy, what is the state of your home world now?
From what we've heard, nothing like@the King of Ruin has appeared, but...
(It's similar to how the Fury@were driven from their home world...)
The current state of our planet is the greatest@secret Herluga is hiding...
And my brother may have found out about it,@and been silenced...
Damn it, they take the Cross Gate,@and all we can do is slink away!
But the enemy's forces were overwhelming.@Withdrawing there was the correct tactical decision.
Not on the scale of the <White Star>,@but an entire fortress warped in, after all...
Even if the odds are bad,@there's no point betting if the payout isn't big.
...What's going to happen@to Captain Ginto?
That withdrawal order practically saved us...
Right call or not, there's no denying@he disobeyed the unit commander's orders.
Then he'll stay locked up...?
That's possible.
No...
But it's not a matter we can interfere in.
All we can do is wait for our next orders...
Which comes first: our chance for revenge,@or the Rabulpaila jumping again...?
Either way, I wish they'd decide what to do soon.
Leaving the Cross Gate with Herluga is like@letting someone do a fire dance@in front of a powder keg.
The dancer'd be the first one blown sky-high.
Naturally, they must be planning some countermeasure.
Something other than the Zemon Mortar?
Yes.@For instance, mobile weapons@equipped with Siebe Drives.
I don't care what tricks they have up their sleeve.@We knock them off the Cross Gate before@the Rabulpaila jumps... That's all.
I see... So when they talk about restoring Gadisword,@that might be what they really mean...
...In the worst case.
If that's true... then we...
Sieg...
B-But we don't know@that for sure yet, right...?
To find out what happened to our planet,@we have no choice but to go to the Rabulpaila.
And stop Herluga, and end@the war between Gadisword and Earth.
We'll help too, Fairy.
Jinpu
Now, I have a proposal.
What is it, Jinpu?
Powering up the Super Soul Saber.
For real?!
But it's not power@you can use anytime, anywhere.
Could it be... the Siebe Drive?
Yeah. We transplant it from the Ariard into the@Super Soul Saber and use it as an auxiliary engine.
It's Dr. Wan's idea.@Honestly, I'm not too keen on it...
But it'll boost the Super Soul Saber's@output even more, right?
Yeah. The GG in particular will be able to use@the Ultimate Blaster, which is even stronger@than the normal Buster Blaster.
In exchange, there's no telling what the risks are.@You still wanna do it?
Yeah.@We can't let Herluga have the Cross Gate.@Right, Akemi?
Right. If the Zemon Mortar were fired@at Earth, the moon or the colonies,@it'd be a disaster.
Plus, there's a chance Herluga's got mobile@weapons with Siebe Drives, too.
...He surely has them.@Jinpu, I understand the risks.@Please, I'm asking you too.
All right.@Turns out Dr. Wan's been secretly drawing up a work@schedule for a while. The job itself won't take long.
...Do you have anything to say in your defense?
No.
You've disappointed me, Colonel. A survivor of the@Orbital Patrol 4th Fleet, wiped out defending Selene@Base late in the <Inspector Incident>...
You lost your ship and most of your crew,@yet I selected you as captain of the Hagane.
Because I thought that defeat had made you@a more careful commander.
...Back then, the base we were to defend was destroyed@too. But given our gap in strength with the <Einst>,@the outcome was clear without even fighting.
We should have supported the base personnel's@escape and withdrawn the fleet as well.
You're saying your superior...@the fleet commander's judgment was wrong?
Yes.@Including my own for obeying,@though I foresaw the result.
Don't judge by hindsight.
...Is that so?
You have an objection?
If we value only the order of the chain of command,@and the Steel Dragons are lost as a result...@that is a great loss for humanity.
If my career alone can save them from@the brink of destruction, then I should do it@without hesitation...
That is what I learned from that defeat.
So you were prepared for this.@Very well. Your fate will be decided at a court-martial@after the operation is over.
...Sir.
(This is fine... I've already taught@the Hagane's crew all I can.)
(And they've inherited the will of their former@captain, Daitetsu Minase. Even without me,@they'll fight on to the very end...)
